source.title: Marconi Archer Tactical Troposcatter
source.summary: Marconi describes Archer as a rugged tactical troposcatter terminal with more than 200 kilometres of stated range, toolless setup, automatic alignment, adaptive coding, encryption, and anti-jamming.

followUpQuestions: Ask for the FMV test plan and absolute results, then compare band, throughput, latency, crew, transport, interoperability, and environmental requirements against the intended backhaul task.
reviewWarnings: The public release does not disclose absolute throughput, latency, frequency bands, link availability statistics, test acceptance criteria, contract scope, or independent FMV reporting.
